title: Be a Farmer
author: Shellfie original
credit: An original story written for Shellfie.

pages: Cock-a-doodle-doo! The rooster wakes you up. It is still dark!
You work on a farm, with fields, a barn, and animals.
You wear boots, overalls, gloves, and a big hat.
You feed the cows and the chickens. You milk the cows.
Then you drive the tractor to plant corn.
Hey! A goat ate your hat!
You work with your family, farm helpers, and a vet for the animals.
The best part? You are outside all day, and you grow food for people.
The hardest part? You work very early, and bad weather can hurt your plants.
How do you become a farmer? Many farmers learn by working on a farm. Some go to college for 2 to 4 years to study farming.
What can you do now? Plant a seed in a cup. Visit a farm or a farmers market. Join a 4-H club.
